note: v1 (FIRST DRAFT): THE WARM THIRD. Relief, the first orbit closing, 136 bars (~300 s), 108 -> 112 bpm, flat across both 16-bar seams. E4 'four lights' (this track's element: D9 / Bbmaj13#11 / Am11 / D9sus, one chord per E1 cycle, 20 beats a turn) is the clock from bar 17, its changes crossing the 4/4 bar lines. E1 (t1's seed, D A C G E) ASSEMBLES ITSELF on a handpan - one note more every two cycles - then answers itself in canon (kalimba, a fifth below, two beats behind) through B and the rise; the felt piano breaks E4 into eighths from 41; upright bass, a sine sub, a half-time brush groove and the chip's noise channel (nes-noise-hat, a 7-in-16 euclid: polymeter against 5 and 20) from 41 to 120. The fall (121-136) hands E1 augmented over the lights to t5.
